data.long_meaning: The name Iscah is recorded with the meaning “Reward of God”. Iscah is a Biblical name meaning “Reward of God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
